_comment: Phase 4.1 corpus-sweep target list (extended 2026-07-27 with 50 more sites — grep 'PHASE 4.3', weighted news/media + entity/structured per request; news URLs discovered live via tools/discover-article-urls.spec.ts against Profile 3, entity URLs are stable direct deep-links). Each entry is a real ARTICLE / content URL the sweep captures, renders, scores (text-coverage, blank-ratio, aspect-distortion, chrome-hits), and screenshots (source/clip/cast). Deep article URLs (not homepages/section hubs) are used deliberately: (1) a single article is the realistic capture target — a homepage's lead-story teaser is a hero + no body, which the scorer mistakes for a broken clip; (2) CF/bot walls hit homepages/section indexes far harder than individual articles, so a deep-link also clears several sites a hub URL gets blocked on. These URLs were discovered live from each site's section page via tests/e2e/tools/discover-article-urls.mjs (run against the warm Cloudflare-cleared Chrome Profile 3) on 2026-07-21 — NOT hand-written, so they were real+loading when added. Article URLs rot: when a formerly-good site starts skipping with 'load failed', re-run the discovery tool to refresh its URL. Sweep runs against the same warm profile. A URL that won't load is a SKIP, not a scored finding; paywalls + IP-level 403s will still skip and that's expected. 'format' defaults to 'article'.
